effects.description:
Sick-Sick Treasure Areas can unleash an area attack that deals damage (49 Power) and reduces the enemy's ATK by 20% for 10 seconds (Cannot Stack) with a chance to inflict Recovery Blocked (Short) for 15 seconds.
The Sick-Sick transformation will disappear after you capture Treasure, when interrupted while capturing Treasure, or after you are KO'd.

skills.detail:
HP will be recovered.
Deals a close-range attack while the skill button is held down. Each time a fixed period of time passes, apple bombs are created at close-range.
Reduces damage taken and reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.
If an enemy touches an apple bomb, it explodes and deals damage while also inflicting a SPD debuff.
The apple bombs will disappear after they are touched by an enemy or after a certain amount of time passes.

Unleashes a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.
Increases own SPD.
You are able to move while holding down the skill button.

Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Okay... Let's Go, Stronger

skills.detail:
Begin charging by holding down the skill button.
Reduces damage taken and reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
This skill cannot be used in certain areas that have obstacles overhead.
There is a cooldown in effect for a set period of time at the start of battle.

When the Enemy Has a Treasure Area:
If you let go of the skill button before the charge has completed, the charge will cancel and you will travel to a certain area. If the charge has finished, you will travel to a different area.

Not Charged:
Moves the user to the nearest enemy Treasure Area.
A mid-range area attack that inflicts a SPD debuff.
Attack ignores obstacles.
Increases own SPD.

Charged:
Moves the user to the furthest enemy Treasure Area.
A mid-range area attack that inflicts a SPD debuff.
Attack ignores obstacles.
Increases own SPD.

When the Enemy Has No Treasure Area:
After a certain amount of time has passed or when the skill button is released, the charge will cancel and your SPD will increase.
